s3c_overlay_on_s1.construction: S1 weekly band-ensemble trades executed AT the overnight-window print (perp's post-RTH-close/pre-RTH-open price) instead of an evenly-spread intraday assumption; scored against the SAME S1 funding P&L stream since funding accrual is execution-timing-independent -- the overlay can only affect realized turnover cost, not the funding leg itself
s3c_overlay_on_s1.note: identical to baseline: the declared flat-bp cost model (13bp RT primary) carries no time-of-day cost variation, so concentrating S1's execution into the overnight window cannot change realized Sharpe under this cost model -- reported honestly as a null overlay result (Delta Sharpe = 0.000) rather than fabricating a slippage differential the data does not support estimating.

pbo.note: CSCV-PBO computed within each sleeve's own native cadence family (S1 daily cells, S1 weekly cells, S3 weekly cells, S2's full 48-cell family aligned on its shortest member's tail) since S1(daily) and S1/S3(weekly)/S2(mixed daily+weekly, 1min/5min) do not share a common native clock to pool into one CSCV split without resampling one onto the other's calendar.
